english_contextual_gloss: chess, the game played by Herbert and his father.
fakir, here a holy man from India; «faquires» is the plural.
warning; Morris asks Mr. White to remember his warning.
British pounds, a unit of money.
to twist or writhe; «se retorció» is how Mr. White describes the paw’s movement.
shiver, sudden feeling of cold or fear.
an animal’s paw; here, the dried object Morris brings.
a place covered in deep mud.
shriveled or contracted; «encogida» describes the paw.
small decorative or protective cloth; here, a cover for a chair back.
sideboard, a piece of dining-room furniture.
to swear that something is true.
compensation, money paid after a loss.
pale, referring to a woman’s face.
strand or thread; the visitor picks one from his trousers.
to bury; «enterraron a Herbert». Related noun in this part: «entierro», burial or funeral.
to whisper; «susurró» describes how the third wish is spoken.
to feel around with the hand.
stair landing; the area at the top of a flight or between flights of stairs.
to break free; «se liberó de un tirón» means she pulled herself free with a sudden movement.
to go out, as a flame does.
resignation; accepting a loss without hope of changing it.
to creak; «crujió» describes the stair and the moving bolt.
to slide; used of the bolt moving back.
disappointment; part of the mother’s response at the open door.
